setting.help: One-click package configuration
Recency, Frequency, Monetary customer segmentation (Always Enabled)

Shows how actively customers interact with your business. Looks at email opens and clicks, website visits and purchases, and WhatsApp message responses over the last 90 days. Customers who engage more across multiple channels get higher scores.

div.small: Fine-tune engagement calculation parameters. Period: 30-365 days. Points: 1-50 range.

setting.help: Tracks how customers respond to your email campaigns. Counts email opens, clicks, and replies over the last 90 days. More interactions mean higher engagement scores, showing customers who are most interested in your email marketing.

Measures how actively customers participate in your WhatsApp campaigns. Counts participation in completed and ongoing WhatsApp campaigns, plus response rates to messages. Active participants get higher scores.
Tracks how often customers visit your website and make purchases. Based on order frequency and recency over the last 90 days. Customers with more recent and frequent orders get higher scores.

Tracks where customers are in their relationship with your business. Based on purchase history and time since last order: new prospects who haven't bought, first-time buyers, active customers, loyal repeat buyers, and dormant customers who haven't purchased recently.

Identifies customers who might stop buying from you soon. Analyzes how recently they purchased, how often they buy, their engagement with emails and messages, and their overall activity pattern. Customers with declining activity get higher risk scores.

div.small: Risk thresholds must be in descending order. Values: 0-100%. Used to classify customer churn risk levels.
Customers in spending tiers below this amount will be excluded from win-back campaigns. This prevents marketing to low-value customers.

setting.help: Tracks how customers prefer to interact with your business. Counts how many channels they use (email, phone, website, WhatsApp) and identifies their most active channel based on purchase behavior and message activity.

div.small: Consistency scores for multichannel behavior. Higher touchpoints = higher scores. Values: 0-100.

setting.help: Groups customers by when they first purchased and tracks how many return over time. Shows which months or periods brought the most loyal customers. Based on order dates and customer retention patterns. Use this to identify the best times to acquire customers and measure long-term customer loyalty.

Analyze customer age groups, spending tiers, and demographic patterns to optimize marketing strategies and customer segmentation. Provides insights into customer distribution across different age and spending categories.

div.small: Age limit: 50-200 years. New customer threshold: minimum 1 order.

setting.help: Track customer acquisition sources and channels to measure marketing ROI and optimize acquisition spend across different touchpoints. Identifies which channels bring the most valuable customers.

div.small: Period: 30-1095 days (3 years max). Used for customer lifetime and RFM calculations.

setting.help: Identifies customers who prioritize personal values over price when shopping. Analyzes their purchase history to find preferences for eco-friendly products, premium quality items, and socially responsible brands.

div.small: Strong preference: minimum score for highlighting customer preferences. Targeting: minimum score for primary messaging recommendations.

setting.help: Shows how much customers prefer environmentally-friendly products. Calculates the percentage of their purchases that include eco-friendly, organic, sustainable, green, bio, or natural products. Loyal customers get a bonus score.

Identifies customers who are willing to pay more for higher-quality products. Based on their average purchase amount: higher spenders get higher scores. Looks at all their order history to determine their typical spending level.

Shows customers who prefer socially responsible brands. Calculates the percentage of their purchases that include fair trade, ethical, charity, community, or social cause products. Higher percentages mean stronger preference for responsible brands.

Analyze customer purchase patterns across product categories to identify preferences, diversity, and changes in buying behavior over time. Shows which customers have diverse shopping habits versus focused interests.

div.small: Weights must sum to 1.0. Change thresholds: 5-100%. High diversity threshold must be greater than medium (0-100).

setting.help: Tracks which customers come from social media platforms. Analyzes order sources to identify customers from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Twitter. Counts how many orders came from each platform.

div.small: Enter comma-separated keywords for each platform (e.g., facebook,fb)

setting.help: Tracks which specific marketing campaigns, ads, or links bring customers to your store. Analyzes special tracking codes in URLs to show which Facebook ads, Google ads, or email campaigns work best. Based on order sources and campaign tracking data. Use this to see which marketing efforts actually drive sales and where to spend your advertising budget.

Measures how actively customers interact with your social media content and how often they click through to buy. Tracks likes, shares, comments, and purchases from social platforms. Based on social media activity and conversion tracking. Use this to create more engaging social content and identify customers who are most responsive to social media marketing.

Identifies customers who prefer Buy Now, Pay Later payment options. Looks at payment terms used in their orders to find installment, split payment, or BNPL service usage (like Klarna, Afterpay, Affirm). Frequent users get higher scores.

Shows whether customers prefer to shop on mobile devices or desktop computers. Analyzes order timing and amounts to identify mobile shoppers (typically smaller orders placed outside business hours) versus desktop shoppers.

div.small: Orders below this amount are considered mobile commerce indicators.
Hours: 0-23. Preference threshold: 1.0-3.0. Conversion multiplier: 0.1-2.0. Default score: 0-100.
